title: SpecialModelLoader Updated
description: An updated version of Special ModelLoader
body:
# Special Model Loader Renewed

> **This is a library mod.** Do not install it manually; add it as a dependency in your project.

A modernized, actively maintained fork of [Special Model Loader](https://modrinth.com/mod/special-model-loader), a Fabric dependency that enables loading Wavefront `.obj` models in Minecraft. Inspired by [FOML](https://github.com/MehVahdJukaar/FabricObjModelLoader) and [Myron](https://modrinth.com/mod/myron).

## Features

- Full support for Wavefront `.obj` model loading in Fabric mods
- Lightweight, drop-in dependency with minimal overhead
- Actively maintained with a modernized codebase

## Usage

See the [Wiki](https://codeberg.org/Mod-Sauce/SpecialModelLoader) for setup guides, model loading documentation, and full API reference.

## Credits

Built on the work of the Felnull developers and contributors to FOML and Myron.

## Support

Found a bug or need help? Join our [Discord](discord.gg/VNrzdd5ErJ) or open an issue on [Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/Mod-Sauce/SpecialModelLoader).
